questions.scenario: A consultant opens Claude for a one-off market summary and first switches on Research, a Project and every connector, just in case. Which of the four decisions did they get wrong?
questions.a: Capability features: they switched on everything instead of what the job needs.
questions.b: Entry point: a market summary has to be handed off to Code.
questions.c: Model: only Opus is allowed to write summaries.
questions.d: Context: Claude can't see files from connectors at all.
questions.why: The features decision asks what the task needs beyond a conversation, and a one-off summary needs none of the extras.
questions.quote: Switch on what the job needs, not everything
